Epic: bd-01M1Z987V50254M59P9MNGP9FH
Delivery phase: 3 of 6; child 6 of 12.
Design: docs/design/interaction.md; full snapshot retained in the epic note.
Status: planned work; no implementation or passing evidence is asserted.

Scope
Implement shared or projected hover/selection across plots and panels with explicit key-space mappings. Link legends to marks in both directions and expose framework-neutral event/state APIs for application control.

Acceptance criteria
1. Two scatter plots with different row order emphasize/select the same observation keys; category legend hover and selection link to the corresponding marks.
2. Equal display labels in unrelated namespaces never join. Missing keys and data replacement follow the declared reconciliation policy.
3. External state changes and projected updates do not create feedback loops, repeated user events, or accidental global widget state.
4. Linked axes validate scale/domain compatibility or require an explicit checked conversion.
5. The example includes a histogram with explicitly bin-level selection; it does not misrepresent that as source-member selection.

Exclusions
Exact aggregate-to-source selection and automatic filtering are not part of this baseline linking task.

Required evidence
Real-browser multi-widget traces, programmatic update probes, namespace/cycle adversarial cases, and the two-scatters-plus-histogram example.
Retain tested source SHA, fixture inputs, expected outputs, and actual gate results. Pending or unavailable checks remain explicitly pending.

Prerequisites
bd-01M1Z9B1VT19HE55FNS365YVRJ

Coordination
Reserve only actual files when implementation starts. Parent containment is not a prerequisite on the epic; do not create a child-to-epic dependency cycle.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 06] Coordinate linked plots, guides, and externally controlled selections
